title: Relock Fee Calculation Sheet, Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
**Relock term and fee.** A relock of a Builder Extended Rate Lock runs the term's relock term days, in calendar days, from the relock date: the new lock expiration date is the relock date plus those days. The relock fee is the relock fee percent of the loan amount on the lock, rounded half up to the cent, with a floor of the term's minimum relock fee. The relock fee percent is the relock fee percent of the lock's term.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Lock term | the lock record (its term name) |
| Loan amount on the lock | the lock record |
| Relock fee percent and minimum relock fee | the product's relock figures for the lock's term |
| Relock term days | the product's relock figures for the lock's term |
| Relock date | the date the relock is written |

## How the fee is formed

1. The amount is first the relock fee percent of the loan amount on the lock.
2. That amount is rounded half up to the cent.
3. Where the rounded amount is below the term's minimum relock fee, the fee is the minimum; otherwise it is the rounded amount.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Loan amount | Relock fee percent | Minimum relock fee | Percent of the loan amount | Rounded | Relock fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 385000.00 | 0.375 | USD 350.00 | 1443.75 | 1443.75 | USD 1443.75 |
| USD 412345.00 | 0.250 | USD 250.00 | 1030.8625 | 1030.86 | USD 1030.86 |
| USD 60000.00 | 0.250 | USD 250.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | USD 250.00 |

Relock term, hypothetical: a relock written on 2 June on a term whose relock runs 30 days carries a new lock expiration date of 2 July.
